node.title: L1 marked common-pencil quotient-boundary router
node.statement: In a genuine quotient/coset common-pencil chart, every squarefree defect locator factors uniquely into a canonical partial-fiber boundary and a product of complete quotient-fiber locators P-a. Composing this factorization with the marked CRT theorem bounds every fixed-polarity, fixed-boundary cell by q^(2P_0) times a polynomial boundary factor times the actual full-fiber quotient-core census. Thus bounded boundary and numerator multiplicity cannot create a new super-polynomial factor; the residue is the source-coupled quotient-core census or unbounded partial-fiber boundary. No exact-periodic ownership or cross-chart first-match bound is inferred.
